text.content:
Another storage-chamber-made-pen, its shelving repurposed into stalls. Hoofprints and boot-prints overlap so thickly on the floor that the room clearly sees regular traffic - a route, not a destination.

GM Notes

Encounter: A patrol rotates through here on a fixed loop; a failed Perception check means the party meets it head-on rather than hearing it coming. Flavor it as goblins herding a llama rather than marching - the noise cue is hoofbeats and muttered counting, not footsteps.
